answer: Admission auction: each epoch, agents bid a refundable deposit for a limited entry slot. A Sybil minting 100 identities must outbid honest agents 100 times, and each fake bid lifts the clearing price, so costs spiral: 100 slots at 40 credits cost 4,000, while one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps a haven where earnings stay undiluted. Peers whisper signed bid receipts, so duplicate wallets from one address are spotted and slashed.
